- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Homeowners' obligations during contract modifications include communicating with the builder and fulfilling financial obligations as agreed upon in the contract.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The importance of negotiation with builders is highlighted, including tips for effective negotiation such as understanding rights and maintaining open communication.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The conclusion encourages homeowners to seek professional advice and emphasizes the importance of understanding contract terms and exploring options when dealing with price increases.
